question: What special powers arise from this stage of yogic practice?
premises: Knowledge of distant hearing is attained
These are presented as additional results
inference: This practice yields knowledge of distant hearing and the power to paralyze bonds.
uncertainties: pāśa-stobham may mean paralysis of bonds or immobilization of fetters
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of hearing from afar and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
